notes.title: 2023 Roadmap & Price Increase
notes.content:
Hello our favourite babies and daddies! 

Two years ago, Who's Your Daddy?! entered our free playtest on Steam and since then we’ve added a lot of content through our monthly updates. In light of the amount of content already added and what is to come, we’ve decided to update the price of Who’s Your Daddy?! to $9.99.

We will continue to offer the free playtest on Steam, and keep the “Playtest” tag onto the game for the time being - so you can still play Who’s Your Daddy?! for free on Steam.

We would like to take this chance to thank our players for your continued support, and for getting Who’s Your Daddy?! this far! We hope you understand and support this decision. We can’t wait to bring you another year of ridiculous content updates!

Who’s Your Daddy?! will be part of the Steam Winter Sales, if you’re looking for a barging!

The 2023 Roadmap is here!
We are so grateful for our amazing communities’ support throughout the lifetime of this game. We excited to announce we have another full year of development planned! The roadmap is of course subject to change, but these are our goals for the year!

notes.title: April 2022 Playtest Update New item and Energy rework!
notes.content:
Hello babies, daddies and plastic bags

The April update has been released!
The April Update has just been released 🎉 including a new item and a energy rework. Now you can finally end your days with your head comfortably in your favorite plastic bag.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/03345cb61b87fcdbe342433a9fdcc7408d082b24.gif

Read the full Patch notes here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/19d48da44e9662284ade94c60fad3b57fc737104.png

New Item: Plastic Bag - Don’t let babies play with plastic bags!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/031dabf936e2479b9a74075332dbf2066a4f3c04.png
Energy Rework:
Our goal with this update is to make Energy feel more like a “resource”. Players will want to take advantage of energy giving items like soda, fruit and water to allow for maximum energy usage.

Energy is now used slower when running & jumping, but also recharges slower
10 energy loss for feeding a healthy item and 30 energy loss for feeding an unhealthy item (the logic here is that it take a lot less energy to feed a baby some fruit, than to feed a baby a handheld vacuum)
Health no longer affects energy recharge rate
10 energy lost for stealing an item from baby (they have a stronger grip than you think)
 Energy recharge at same rate whether walking/standing (so if not running)

Seeding & Tree Daddy

Seedling Shout energy cost reduced from 40 to 20
Daddy Tree Form energy cost reduced to 50 (from 75)
Daddy Tree Form now rapidly recharges energy and heals the daddy

Soda

 Now restores 100 energy on consumption

Sugar Rush (Rewarded from drinking Soda) 

On activation, Sugar Rush will remove a Sugar Crash
The player now receives 10x times energy regen when on a sugar rush
If there are multiple sugar rush buffs, The Sugar crash buff is not given until the last one expires
Players can now walk in sugar rush, to take advantage of the energy regen

Sugar Crash (Consequence for consuming sugar)

Debuff now lasts 30 seconds (previously 10)
The player loses 50% of their current energy

Hydrated Buff (Rewarded from drinking a water bottle)

Now removes sugar crash debuff
Now lasts 60 seconds(previously 30). 
Doubles stamina recharge rate per buff. (Previously cut stamina usage by 50% per buff)

Passing Out

Now makes daddy loss all energy
On revival 25 energy is gifted.
If you hit the heart successfully 3 times, you are rewarded an additional 75 energy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/830a8f05b200139f61a7b394f48a459b6f0341d4.png

Daddies are now invulnerable for 1 second after passing out
Garage Cabinets  now spawn a more appropriate set of items
Added more fruit bowl arrangements throughout the home
Added lots of water to the map - stay hydrated out there
Add many Impact sounds to a number of items

notes.content:
Hello babies, daddies and delicious gingerbread men

The December update has been released!
It's that time a year, and the December update is here
With much fun in the snow, many snowballs you can throw
And with the UI overhaul, you'll have a better experience over all
We've optimized the game a bit, before it was pretty ....
Also many bugs we have squished, you can see them on the patch notes list
So go hunt new achievements, experience your fulfillments
Enjoy the new winter theme, happy holidays from the team!

Detailed Patch Notes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/19d48da44e9662284ade94c60fad3b57fc737104.png

Holiday Items
 Presents - Break open to get a surprise!
  Pine Tree - Has delightful edible ornaments
  Santa Hats - Bring home a surprise and spawn with a present!
 Snowballs (only in snowy weather)
 Throw snow at other players to make the slow and cold
 Move snowballs to "attach" it to other snowballs
 Roll snow around the yard to make it bigger
 Watch out for the yellow Snowballs!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/830a8f05b200139f61a7b394f48a459b6f0341d4.png

 New Weather Option: Snowy! You can now set the map weather as "snowy". We have set the default mode to snowy, and will change this in the spring.
 Optimization
 Added an Occlusion culling system that should increase fps in most situations.
 Improved performance in Split-Screen
 Achievements - There are now 13 achievements unlock-able in the Remake. 5 of these are new, while the other 8 are also unlock-able in classic. We plan to add more achievements throughout 2022.
 Removed Halloween Decorations


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/62a934df068b2cb549502d56cd767c4ee1bbb958.png

 New Winter Theme in menu!

notes.title: March 2021 Playtest Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We're back with another update to the Playtest! 

We've added a couple of items to help Daddies, and a couple to help babies! We have also managed to fix a lot of the issues that caused players to fall out of the map. We imagine there are still some more, so please tell us if this is continuing to happen to you! There are also a number of general improvements we have made to the UI and networking, you can read more below! 

The next update is coming March 26th, 2021!

 Mar 1 Hotfix

 The recent update introduced a feature that automatically connected you to a lobby server based on region, but this was not intended. We will add the ability to choose your region in a later update.

All Players now connect to the same lobby server.


Detailed Patch Notes

New Items

Binky - Feed this to your baby to prevent eating and drinking for 30 seconds
Candle - can ignite gasoline
Soap Bar - Use soap to clean up messes made by Ketchup, Gasoline or other liquids
 Lollipop - Sticks to stuff and gives a rush of sugar
 Cookie - Gives a rush of sugar

Map Changes

Air Vents - The Air vents allows babies to quickly move from one spot to another. There is currently one in the Living Room and one in the Kitchen. The cover is edible, but we don't recommend eating metal.

Added an underside to the sink. There is also a valve underneath the sink that can only be used by daddies to shut the sink off.
Added a switch that controls the ceiling fan
Daddies can now swing on some of the lights in the living room

Item Changes

Updated the Power Outlet model

Character Changes

For passed out Daddies: 3 successful chest compressions will now instantly pick you up
Characters now get up sooner after ragdolling
Adjusted size of Daddy's prone collider
Babies can no longer pickup furniture

Music & Sound

There is now a unique track that plays when returning to the lobby
There is now a unique track that plays when a character is on fire
Fixed a bug that caused jump sounds from opposing players to always play at full volume
Added a lobby countdown sound
Fire now has a sound
Bouncing on Couches & the Bean Bag has a new sound
Fixed an issue where walking/jumping on carpets played the wrong sound

Camera Polish

Camera no longer jumps up after ragdolling
The camera now follows characters better when crouch jumping & switching between crouching/standing
Made changes to how the camera follows the player while ragdolling

UI

Changed the mouse control icon to something more inline with the other control icons.
Improved PlayStation Controller support: Play Station Controllers will now show the appropriate icons. (For the time being, it is required to turn Steam Input off when playstation controllers, we will fix this soon)
Made several changes involving the "On Screen Controls" in the bottom right corner: 
Displays the name of the object you are currently detecting
Displays a tip for objects that have one (The baby also has some tips that show depending on it's status)
Switch the left/right mouse click icons to something more inline with the others
Renamed "Drop" (when holding an item) to "Move" as this does the same thing when you "Move" an item you are detecting
In the Rules menu, the item list is now alphabetized. 

Bug Fixes

Made a fix that should prevent daddies from "wall hacking" by crouching with their back against a wall.
Fixed a bug where characters could clip through walls/floors when getting up after ragdolling. Please let us know if you find any other ways to get through walls using this glitch or another, this is an area we will continue to pay attention to.
fixed up some animation issues when getting up after ragdolling
Fixed an issue that allowed players to use/detect items while climbing
Fixed a few issues with feeding the baby
 Made improvements to character and ragdoll syncing


5:15pm EST Hotfix changes

Fixed the outlet covers freezing the daddy
Changed the font of the room codes to something more readable
Fixed an issue where drinking did not stop automatically
Fixed an issue that prevented the binky sound from playing
Fixed an issue that allowed the baby to eat from the battery tray while "binkied"
Added a collider to the living room window
Fire soundtrack will now loop if you are still burning
Ball Blaster Updates

 Now Knocks out daddies for head and pelvis shots
 Daddies and Babies drop what they were holding after being blasted by a ball

Made an improvement to ragdoll syncing
Added a fix for the left hand getting stuck on doors
Fixed a bug that caused Underwater sounds to play for all players


 10PM EST Hotfix

Changed the game's DirectX version to 11. This appears to prevent some crashes, and generally increase performance.


We are starting to focus on crash reports, please submit a report through our Support Form for further instructions if you have experienced a crash.

Thanks for playing!!

Evil Tortilla Games

notes.title: February 2021 Playtest Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are very excited to release the first monthly update for the New Who's Your Daddy?! This update focuses on bug fixes and performance improvements, but we've also added a new item and lobbies now support chat! We have listed the full change list below if you'd like to know all the details.

We are very grateful to see such a level of engagement from the community for our first live build! We have received many helpful bug reports and suggestions that have assisted in fixing some of the major issues within the initial release. We'll be back next month with more fixes and new items!

We understand that many players are expecting more rooms in this release. We currently do not have a release date set for the remaining rooms because we want to take some more time to focus on quality improvement for the preexisting areas. We will continue to release monthly updates and remain in a Playtest state until all rooms are released, while also fixing major bugs and adding new features along the way.

The next update is coming February 26th, 2021!

Detailed Patch Notes

New Content

New Item: Can of Beans - Beans completely heal Daddy. Do NOT let your baby eat the entire can of beans.

Daddy Changes

Daddy now always revives with 75% health
Successful Heartbeats reduce 2.4 seconds of passed out time (was previously 0.6 seconds)
Fixed a bug were feeding the baby would teleport them to the living room

Baby Changes

Babies have some level of "air control" now
Babies can now see each others stats by looking at one another

Map Changes

Removed Consistent Fork & Hammer Spawns - All fork spawns are based on a randomized system now that follows the item control spawn menu rules.
Adjusted ceiling lights in the living room
Added a bean bag to the living room - this works similar to the new couches
The Ceiling fan now knocks out the daddy if it hits him in the head

 Item Changes

Eating is now a lot faster
Hammer can now be swung to deal damage to daddies and break furniture
Locks now work on the fridge and microwave
Pills now restore stamina and remove all buffs/debuffs
Furniture can now only be broken with hammers or a ragdolling character
Fixed an issue where throwing soda caused you to hurt yourself as a daddy
Eating whole pieces of meat(raw/cooked/burnt/spoiled) will now reduce your energy
Vacuum is now much more powerful and easier to use (this is the "ideal" way to remove broken pieces of stuff)
Fixed an issue where clients would hold the vacuum in a ridiculously unusable way in online games
Ketchup & Mustard effects improved
Sofas are now bouncy and can be shoved around
You can now hold the action button down(default left click) to use an item as soon as you pick it up
Waste basket no longer turns pink
Apples and Bananas are now 33% larger
 Moving items is now done with the drop button (Default R) instead of holding e (control tips show this)
Drinkable containers can now be eaten after drinking them
 Shards (Anything that is broken) - now have a standard damage (-1) and sickness rate (-5).
Ceiling lights now reduce the baby's energy at a rate of 5 per second

Netcode

We have made some changes that will help stabilize item jitter for players with high ping.

UI Update

Lobbies now have chat!
Added a 1 Minute timer for the end of the match
Added a new post processing effecting for sickness called "Sickness Effect" in the options
Rules/Item Menu now scrolls at an appropriate speed
Fixed a bug where cloing the menu without saving would make multiple menus show
 Various Item control texts have been fixed
 Refresh button in Online Custom Lobby Search Menu has been fixed
 Added an in-game help button on the menu that displays info on the stats

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where drinking soda could cause you to leave the house against your will
Fixed a bug where eating a forking caused the screen to fill up with debuffs (we will add in the debuff at a later date)
The Fridge no longer explodes after opening it
Players can now back out of the quickplay queues in online menus
Outlet Covers now work as intended in online play
Ace in the Hole Perk now works as intended
First person is now the default camera view for new players - you can switch between first and third person using "T" by default 
Skin Tone Selector now works with the mouse
Removed an invisible jar in the kitchen

New Sounds

The lighter now has an on/off sound
Furniture now has a breaking sound
New Music & More sounds coming soon!!!

Performance Improvements

The character reflections on the screens were causing major performance issues. We may continue to optimize them, but they are now off by default, improving general performance up to 30-100%
Limited fire to 50 instances for performance reasons


Thanks for playing!!

Evil Tortilla Games

notes.title: Who's Your Daddy?! Remake: Status Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We are extremely excited to showcase all the new features and content included in this new updated version of Who’s Your Daddy?! We believe that this update will take the game to a whole new level of quality while still maintaining that quirky vibe that players have come to enjoy! This isn’t just a remaster, we’ve redone EVERYTHING.

We have been having alot of fun designing new content for this update, but we have also been working very hard to deliver it into your hands! The release coming at the end of the year will feature exclusively The Kitchen and The Living Room, similar to the OG Alpha that was released 5 years ago to date. These rooms feature a complete experience of what to expect from Who's Your Daddy, with many new surprises! This new release WILL NOT delete or overwrite the current version of Who’s Your Daddy. This update will add an additional launch option when opening the game, It will be like having 2 games in 1!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/3c1ed95bd8de4c5f80806e731b47cb08a087a1c7.png

Last year, our team announced this remake would be released on December 23, 2020. We are still striving to hit this release date! However, some of the content featured in the video will not be available for the initial release. Don’t worry! This content will still be coming in future updates! We simply need more time to create content that holds up to the standards of quality gameplay that our players deserve! Every individual room should be able to offer complete, unadulterated gameplay, therefore, the focus for future updates will be on new rooms, new interactions, and fixing bugs. 

On a personal note, I feel extremely honored to be working with the most amazing team and dedicating my career to making this game the best it can be. I am so excited and grateful to be a part of a huge community that offers such extensive support. I genuinely can't thank you all enough for playing and enjoying Who’s Your Daddy! 

From everyone on the team, 
Thank you for all your support!

Joseph Williams
Evil Tortilla Games

notes.title: V1.1.0 - Graphics Optimizations - What to expect for official release?
notes.content:
V1.1.0 is Ready for Download!

The most significant change in this update is increased frame rates cause by improved meshes and several new graphics options including:

Low Quality Textures
Limited View Distance
Low Quality Render Engine


Several other features/fixes come with this update as well:

What to expect for the official release on April 29th

Explorable outside mode with new dangers and chores
22 Achievements to be earned, with an unlockable wearable connected to each one
Increased customization for custom games, options such as turning off specific items, changing round time, and additional win conditions
Various Leaderboards to compete in
And more to be revealed!


The purpose of this release date is to signify the completion of the product which I had originally intended to end up with. However, due to the games extraordinary success, development will be continuing far beyond this point and you can still expect weekly updates for many months to come! Features such as more game modes, new maps, new items, and new characters will be coming at no additional costs to all players!

Have Fun!

notes.title: V0.5.0 is here!
notes.content:
V0.5.0 is now live!

Hi Everyone!

The focus of this update was to fix several severe issues preventing people from properly playing the game. Planned new game modes are found below as well as plans for next weeks update.

Here are the main changes for V0.5.0:
Several Dad black screen issues have been fixed
New Item: Baby Restrainy - Allows you to pick up baby for brief periods of time. Breaks after 3 uses.
Blue screen issues should* be fixed
Many netcode improvements (Especially noticeable when picking up objects as client)
64 Bit builds added for Linux and OSX: Will greatly improve stability for these platforms.
Many bug fixes and balance changes: See Detailed Changelog


Unfortunately this update is not impressive in terms of content, however a lot of networking back-end has been redone to prepare for spilt-screen mode and new game modes in general.

Planned Gamemodes!
There are currently 5 game modes planned to be released over time before the full release of Who's Your Daddy, they are as follows:

Daddy's Little Mistakes
1 Daddy vs 2 babies
 Babies win if either one dies
 Daddy starts off with a pick-up ability, allowing him to hold one baby at a time

Daddy's Nightmare
Daddy's Nightmare is a mode intended for 4 players.
1 Daddy is faced against 3 Babies
The goal is for the babies to kill the Daddy using various objects in the house
The power is out, meaning everything is dark. Daddy is given a flashlight to increase his view distance, at the risk of being seen
Daddy can win by surviving until mom gets home, or by turning on the power

The Hungry Games
1-8 Babies are pitted against each other to survive as long as possible, either by hiding, fighting or whatever means necessary

The Great Dadlympics
1-8 Dads compete to complete as many chores as possible within the time limit

Family Gathering
1-4 Daddys vs 1-4 babies
Everything as normal, allows for more players


What's Planned for Next Week?
Changes Planned:
Chat
2 New Left Hand Items
2 New ways to die
1 New Chore
 2 New Dad Powers to earn
2 New interactions with current Items
Configurable Controls Menu
And more to be revealed next week!


Be sure to post in the discussions with any questions, concerns, or issues you are having!

-Joe

notes.title: Week 1 Annoucement
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

This announcement is to update you with what will be happening in the upcoming weeks as well as further down the road. 

The next update is planned to come January 8th. Here is a general list of what to expect, specifics will be posted once the update is released.

General Updates:

2 New Chores and 1 new Dad Power to earn
3 New Useable Items, beneficial to Daddy: major spawning adjustments are being made as well in his favor
 Air ducts: Allows baby an additional path to traverse through rooms (Can be locked)
 3 new dangerous interactions with existing objects
 Net-code improvements (This is the cause of the dad/baby crash issue)
 And more to soon be revealed!


Once again, this update is scheduled for January 8th  around 4-6pm EST. Future updates can be expected to come every Friday at this time.

For those curious about the other rooms, they are currently in development. They are expected to be released in about 1-2 months depending on what additional features are widely requested by the community. 

I am keeping myself on a tight development schedule, advances in the game's status from alpha to beta to release will be made by substantial changes/additions, such as the unlocking of all additional rooms at once. If all goes as expected, the game will enter full release by March 31th this year. 

Another matter I want to cover is game modes. I currently have an additional 4 unique modes planned for the main release. The specifics will be revealed on the 8th, however match size will range from 2-8 players.
